name: SF-Marin Food Bank
description: The San Francisco-Marin Food Bank works to end hunger in San Francisco and Marin, distributing free groceries (more than 70% fresh produce) through 205 food pantries and partnerships with 265 community organizations.
fullDescription: The San Francisco-Marin Food Bank works to end hunger in San Francisco and Marin, distributing free groceries (more than 70% fresh produce) through 205 food pantries and partnerships with 265 community organizations.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free weekly groceries at 205 food pantries in a farmers market-style setting
- Home-delivered groceries for low-income seniors, adults with disabilities, and some pregnant people and parents of infants or children with disabilities
- Monthly USDA food box for low-income seniors 60+ (Supplemental Food Program)
- One-time emergency food
- CalFresh application and renewal help
- Serves residents regardless of immigration status
howToGetIt: Use the online Food Locator to find weekly groceries, senior food boxes, or emergency food near you. For home-delivered groceries or CalFresh help, call 415-824-3663 (hdg@sfmfoodbank.org for grocery delivery).
keywords: SF-Marin Food Bank, San Francisco, Marin, free food, food pantry, groceries, home delivery, senior food box, CalFresh, produce
